title: Trust Is Part of the Interaction
subtitle: AI workflows that make boundaries, generated output and human control visible

cv.note: Tailored for the Lead Product Designer, AI Agents role

bio.short: I design AI-assisted products around the decisions people still need to understand and control. At Bibel TV, I built a support assistant with explicit boundaries and human review. At Ninox, generated databases remain editable in the real product. I connect this interaction judgment to reusable systems, customer evidence and working prototypes.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I lead product design and hold product responsibility across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. I designed a Microsoft Copilot assistant for viewer services with explicit scope rules, restricted topics and a human edit-and-send decision. The team already had a handbook and house voice. I turned those into a useful drafting standard without making the assistant an autopilot.

At Ninox I designed prompt-to-database onboarding so the generated schema appears in the real data-model editor beside the conversation. People can inspect and change tables and fields directly instead of repairing a complex structure through more prompts. Earlier, I led Product Design for the no-code platform and owned the design system with joint Engineering governance.

My current practice connects the interaction to the system that preserves it. I built a platform-agnostic token architecture that product managers and coding agents can use through Storybook, with checks that refuse off-system values before review. I prototype against production APIs and combine qualitative research with product usage and support signals. I use AI for larger-scale synthesis while keeping human judgment on the evidence and the final decision.

context.company: Zendesk builds customer-service software and AI Agents across messaging, voice and email.
context.role: A Berlin-based Lead Product Designer role owning AI-agent experiences from discovery and strategy through prototyping, launch, iteration and adoption.
context.emphasis: Lead with concrete trust mechanics, inspectable and editable generated output, reusable patterns, working prototypes, customer evidence and Lead-level cross-functional influence.
